prompts.title: Recent Form: Wins, Draws, Losses
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 6–10 s, adapted to the spoken words. Background charcoal #101412 with a faint lime grid. Top title in warm white #edf0e6: FORMA RECIENTE. Subtitle in slate #8ca6bf: Naciones · últimos partidos. Main chart: grouped count bars, three categories on the x-axis — Victorias, Empates, Derrotas — with two bars per category: Francia in lime #c5ed74, Bélgica in slate #8ca6bf. Shared zero baseline and a single count axis labeled partidos. Use values {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. Place count labels directly above each bar. Add team labels Francia and Bélgica in Spanish. Source/sample annotation: Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra: Francia {{home.n}} partidos · Bélgica {{away.n}} partidos. Compare sample sizes and, if unequal, show a discreet badge Muestras desiguales; if equal, show Muestras comparables. Entry: baseline draws first, bars grow upward with 0.4 s stagger, count labels fade after bars settle. Main comparison: grouped bars side by side; keep one focal point by desaturating the grid and non-target labels. Emphasis: soft lime pulse on the tallest bar in each team color, sin tasas ni conversiones and no pronóstico. Camera: slow vertical push from lower baseline to full chart. Transition: horizontal wipe to source footer, then hold. Exit: chart fades to charcoal as lower third clears. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; do not place chart marks or source text inside that band. Keep Spanish labels legible, hierarchy clean, and all quantities resolved by the renderer.

prompts.title: Goals For and Against
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 6–10 s, adapted to the spoken words. Charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 titles, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf data accents. Title: GOLES A FAVOR Y EN CONTRA. Subtitle: Naciones · contexto ofensivo y defensivo. Chart: paired bars for both teams on a shared scale in goles, with a single zero baseline. Show four bars in two pairs: Francia a favor {{home.gf}}, Francia recibidos {{home.ga}}, Bélgica a favor {{away.gf}}, Bélgica recibidos {{away.ga}}. Use Spanish labels: Goles a favor, Goles recibidos, Francia, Bélgica. Keep the football context clear with a small decorative ball icon that is not a data mark. Add source/sample annotation above the subtitle zone: Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra: Francia {{home.n}} partidos · Bélgica {{away.n}} partidos. Entry: baseline draws first; each pair rises together, with value labels fading in after the bar settles. Main comparison: attack vs defence for each team, and the same metric across teams. Emphasis: outline the larger bar in each pair without changing its value; sin tasas ni predicciones. Camera: slight lateral slide to align both pairs, ending with a locked-off full view. Transition: soft cut to the source strip. Exit: labels dim, bars settle, then fade. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; keep all chart marks and Spanish labels outside that band. Use one focal point and professional hierarchy throughout.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets: Counts and Samples
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 6–10 s, adapted to the spoken words. Charcoal #101412 background with warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 for Francia and slate #8ca6bf for Bélgica. Title: ARCOS EN CERO. Subtitle: Naciones · conteos, no tasas. Main chart: two horizontal count bars or vertical columns for Francia and Bélgica, sharing a zero baseline and the unit partidos. Labels in Spanish: Francia · arcos en cero, Bélgica · arcos en cero. Use values {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}. Source/sample annotation: Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra: Francia {{home.n}} partidos · Bélgica {{away.n}} partidos. Do not convert counts into rates or proportions; show only the published clean-sheet counts and their sample sizes. Entry: goal-frame outlines draw first, then bars grow from zero and count labels fade in. Main comparison: direct count comparison, with sample-size labels kept adjacent to each team. Emphasis: a soft lime halo on the larger count; if counts are equal, both bars receive a subtle pulse. Camera: locked-off with a very slow zoom, keeping both bars and labels readable. Transition: crossfade to a source footer that repeats Fuente: Bzzoiro and the sample notes. Exit: bars settle and fade to charcoal. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; no chart marks, values or source text enter that band. Keep Spanish labels legible, no pronóstico, and all quantities resolved by the renderer.

prompts.title: Head-to-Head Historical Counts
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 6–10 s, adapted to the spoken words. Charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 titles, lime #c5ed74 for Francia, slate #8ca6bf for Bélgica, and a neutral warm white for draws. Title: HISTORIAL DE CRUCES. Subtitle: Naciones · datos históricos, no pronóstico. Chart: a segmented count bar or three grouped columns showing Victorias Francia {{h2h.homeWins}}, Empates {{h2h.draws}}, Victorias Bélgica {{h2h.awayWins}}. Shared zero baseline and unit partidos. Add a total bracket: Cruces previos: {{h2h.total}} partidos. Source annotation: Fuente: Bzzoiro · Muestra: {{h2h.total}} cruces. On-screen Spanish labels: Victorias Francia, Empates, Victorias Bélgica, Cruces previos. Include a persistent disclaimer in slate: Histórico · no predice el resultado. Entry: total bracket draws first, then segments fill left to right in team colours, with count labels fading in. Main comparison: three historical counts against the total sample, keeping one focal point on the segmented bar. Emphasis: the total bracket pulses once and the segment labels brighten; sin tasas ni pronóstico. Camera: slow zoom out to reveal the total sample. Transition: vertical wipe to the source footer. Exit: chart fades while the disclaimer remains briefly. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; keep all marks, labels and source text above it. Do not invent future scores or convert counts into rates.

prompts.title: Historical Edge vs Recent Form
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 analytic motion-graphics sequence, 6–10 s, adapted to the spoken words. Charcoal #101412 background, warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 for Francia, slate #8ca6bf for Bélgica, muted warm white for Empates. Title: CONTRASTE ESTADÍSTICO. Subtitle: Naciones · historial vs forma reciente. Two-panel layout. Left panel: HISTORIAL DE CRUCES with sample {{h2h.total}}; counts Francia {{h2h.homeWins}}, Empates {{h2h.draws}}, Bélgica {{h2h.awayWins}}. Right panel: FORMA RECIENTE with samples Francia {{home.n}} and Bélgica {{away.n}}; counts Francia {{home.wins}}, Bélgica {{away.wins}}. Both panels use the unit partidos but keep separate scales and separate sample annotations: Historial: Bzzoiro · Muestra {{h2h.total}} cruces; Forma reciente: Bzzoiro · Muestra {{home.n}} / {{away.n}} partidos. No published model estimates are available, so show no estimates and use no tasa notation. Spanish labels must distinguish history from recent form. Entry: left panel builds first, then right panel, then a connecting line draws between them. Main comparison: the historical advantage for Francia against the recent win count for Bélgica, with draws as context. Emphasis: a restrained pulse on the contrasting values, with a disclaimer: Datos históricos y recientes no predicen el resultado. Camera: slow pan from left to right. Transition: split wipe to a combined source footer. Exit: panels fade to charcoal. Reserve the lower quarter for permanent yellow subtitles; keep all marks, labels and source text above it.
